summary.help_index: {{tools}} tools and {{topics}} guide topics. Describe an action with options.describe.
summary.report: Problem report saved to {{path}} ({{files}} files). Nothing was uploaded.
summary.updates_apply_core: Core update to {{version}} started; it reports progress as core_update.progress.
summary.updates_apply_desktop: The app window is installing Desktop {{version}} (restart: {{restart}}). Read updates to follow it.
summary.continuity: {{offers}} interrupted turns, {{runs}} paused runs; {{active}} running now.
summary.machine_installs_revoked: Forgot the approval for {{command}}; the next run that needs it asks again.
summary.terminal_run: Sent the command to terminal {{name}}. Read it with op: read.
confirm.updates_core: Updates the specrails-core framework from {{current}} to {{version}} for every project.
confirm.updates_desktop: Installs Desktop {{version}} (now {{current}}) and restarts the app ({{restart}}). Running work is interrupted unless restart waits for idle.
confirm.worktrees_remove: Deletes {{count}} retained worktrees ({{names}}){{branches}}. Unpushed or uncommitted work in them is lost.
confirm.terminal_run_new: Opens a new terminal in {{cwd}} and runs `{{command}}`.
confirm.terminal_kill: Closes terminal {{name}} and stops what runs in it.
confirm.continuity_resume: Sends a continuation message to {{count}} interrupted missions; their agents resume and spend tokens.
resume.prompt.quit: Specrails was closed while you were working on my last request. Continue where you left off: check the current state first and do not redo work that is already done.
resume.prompt.update: Specrails restarted to install an update while you were working on my last request. Continue where you left off: check the current state first and do not redo work that is already done.
resume.prompt.crash: Specrails stopped unexpectedly while you were working on my last request. Continue where you left off: check the current state first and do not redo work that is already done.
error.terminal_not_found: No terminal {{id}} in this project. List them with op: list.
error.terminals_disabled: The terminal panel is turned off in this build.
error.no_update: No newer {{target}} version is known; run op: check first.
error.nothing_selected: Pass id or options.items to choose what to remove.
error.process_not_found: No background process {{pid}} in this project.
